symptom: A configuration's Extra JVM parameters (e.g. `-Dhttps.proxyHost=127.0.0.1 -Dhttps.proxyPort=29758`, the proxy mendixlabs/mxcli#131 was filed for) and its Java heap maximum were set in the model and shown by `describe settings`, yet absent from every `mxcli run --local` / `test --local` app — silently
cause: LocalRuntimeOptions.jvmArgs was a fixed list (mxcli's two -D flags, then -jar). Nothing read ServerConfiguration.ExtraJvmParameters or MaxJavaHeapSize on the run path, although the configuration was already resolved there for its constant values
file: cmd/mxcli/runjvm.go (configurationJVMArgs, splitJVMParameters, reportJVMArgs); cmd/mxcli/runconstants.go (chooseConfiguration, extracted); cmd/mxcli/constants_resolve.go (constantChain.JVMArgs); cmd/mxcli/docker/localboot.go (LocalRuntimeOptions.JVMArgs, jvmArgs), localapp.go, runlocal.go; cmd/mxcli/testrunner (RunOptions.JVMArgs); cmd_run.go, cmd_test_run.go
insight: Same shape as the constants of FINDINGS §33: a configuration value reaches Studio Pro's run and not mxcli's, and nothing errors. Resolve it from the SAME configuration choice and the same project read as the constants (chooseConfiguration, carried on constantChain) — a second resolver would drift, a second read would open the project twice. Verify on the process, not the options struct: booted the blank 11.14.0 app with MaxJavaHeapSize 768 and `-Dmxcli.probe="from the configuration" -Dhttps.proxyPort=29758`; /proc/<pid>/cmdline of the runtime JVM held -Xmx768m, `-Dmxcli.probe=from the configuration` (one argument, quotes resolved) and the port, all before -jar; the main build's JVM held none of them. Order is load-bearing: after -jar they are the runtime's arguments, not the JVM's; after mxcli's own -D flags so a deliberate property wins; heap before parameters so an explicit -Xmx wins. The report omits -D values (a trust-store password goes there too; run output reaches CI logs). An unbalanced quote is refused before boot rather than passed on split wrongly. `mxcli docker run` is a separate path and not covered
